mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future stucco damage after repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future stucco damage involves proper maintenance and addressing potential vulnerabilities. Ensure adequate drainage around your home to prevent moisture accumulation near the foundation. Regularly inspect your stucco for small cracks and address them promptly before they worsen. Maintain proper caulking around windows, doors, and utility penetrations to prevent water intrusion. Consider implementing a regular inspection schedule by a professional to identify and mitigate issues early. Proper stucco care can significantly extend its lifespan and prevent costly future repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future stucco damage by ensuring good drainage, promptly repairing small cracks, maintaining caulking around openings, and scheduling professional inspections to catch issues early.
